what: Two layout mockups for the scale-field panel. SYNTHETIC TAPE ONLY -- no print in either file came from the cohort, and no number read off them is evidence about it.

charts.shows: price + rate field + order-flow-imbalance field + log-price-curvature field on a shared x-axis, with a linked Gaussian-bandwidth slider driving both the price smooth and a read line across every field panel
charts.injected: A 5 s bought sweep, B 40 s two-sided churn, C 300 s sold accumulation, D 40 s pressure episode with no rate signature

reproduced_on_relocation.doc_reference: claude/scale_field_price_layouts.md section 4.1 -- the readout is biased high by background, so it is an upper bound, not an estimate

charts.shows: field heatmap and the inter-trade-interval quantile ribbon on ONE shared log-duration axis, plus the ribbon-width panel against the universal Poisson constant and the ITT scatter coloured by field significance
charts.injected: A real 5 s rate hump, V a genuine void, E clumping at constant mean rate (6.46/s inside vs 6.16/s ambient)

reproduced_on_relocation.doc_reference: claude/scale_field_itt_overlay.md sections 2.1, 2.2 and 4 -- every figure quoted there is reproduced above

offline_rule: D14 -- plotly is bundled into each file by include_plotlyjs=True, never a CDN
html_is_gitignored: results/scale_field/charts/*/*.html. Both files are regenerable by running their source script; this manifest is the tracked record that they exist and what they contain.
provenance: Delivered 2026-09-08 in scale_field_bundle/mockups/ and regenerated in place from the committed generators, which is what makes them reproducible rather than imported. Regeneration reproduced every quoted number; file size grew ~550 KB per file, which is the locally installed plotly 6.5.2 bundle, not a content change.
